description:
About OnePay

OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better.

Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We’re fixing it. And we’re moving fast.

We’re an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers.

We’re backed by Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech’s most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category-defining.

But what really sets OnePay apart is how we move. Our customers don’t have time to wait… and neither do we. This place moves fast, and we’re looking for people who are:

  • Ready to run

  • Hungry and driven by urgency

  • Exceptional at what they do, with low ego

  • Comfortable operating in motion

The Role

As the Website & CRO Marketing Manager at OnePay, you will own onepay.com. This role will grow qualified organic traffic and convert it into funded accounts, card applications, and app downloads across every product, from Banking and Invest to Pay Later and Personal Loans. You will run a relentless experimentation program, keep messaging simple, clear and compliant, and work backwards from what customers need to see before they trust us with their money. This is a highly cross-functional role, partnering with Brand, Product Marketing, Growth, Design, Engineering, SEO/Content, and Legal and Compliance. You will:

  • Own the conversion rate strategy, roadmap, and performance of onepay.com, paid landing pages, app store campaigns and the blog

  • Lead conversion rate optimization (CRO) for organic and direct traffic, taking visitors from site visit to app download, account open, and product activation, with clear KPIs and a weekly reporting cadence

  • Build and run a structured experimentation program (A/B and multivariate tests, personalization, and funnel analysis) with a clear hypothesis backlog, so we ship, learn, and scale winners fast

  • Own website analytics end to end (GA4 configuration, Google Tag Manager, event and conversion tracking, dashboards, and attribution) so the team has trusted data, and manage the website tech stack, including CMS, tag management, and testing tools, to ensure speed, Core Web Vitals, and accessibility at scale

  • Work with Legal and Compliance to ensure disclosures, rate and fee language, and FDIC and bank-partner statements are accurate and clearly presented without hurting the customer experience

  • Collaborate with Paid Media and Lifecycle teams to align landing pages, tracking, and attribution with growth campaigns across channel

  • Lead site migrations, redesigns, and performance projects as needed, in partnership with Design and Engineering

  • Be the voice of the customer on the web: use session recordings, surveys, and user research to understand pain points and motivations

You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in conversion rate optimization, with fintech, financial services, or consumer tech strongly preferred

  • A track record of lifting conversion through CRO and experimentation (A/B testing, multivariate testing, funnel and cohort analysis)

  • Hands-on experience with a modern CMS (for example Contentful, Webflow, or WordPress), plus working knowledge of HTML/CSS and front-end performance

  • Strong command of analytics tools (for example GA4, Amplitude, Tableau, and Search Console) and testing tools such as Optimizely, VWO, or Statsig

  • Experience working closely with Legal and Compliance in a regulated environment, and the ability to distill complex financial concepts into simple, compelling copy

  • A self-starter with strong cross-functional collaboration skills, who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and executes with urgency

  • Passion for financial inclusion and creating customer-first experiences

  • Drive and proactivity - everyone here is a builder and executor

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary, stock options, and health benefits from Day 1

  • 401(k) plan with company match

  • Remote-friendly (US), flexible time off (FTO), and opportunities for growth

  • A high-growth, mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work has real impact

Standard Interview Process

Our process varies by role. Most candidates go through:

  • AI-assisted initial screen

  • Interview with Talent Partner

  • Technical or Hiring Manager Interview

  • Team Interview

  • Executive Interview

  • Offer!

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us at talent@onepay.com.
